name: MPL proto-oncogene, thrombopoietin receptor

function.text: MPL encodes the thrombopoietin receptor, which regulates hematopoietic stem-cell maintenance and megakaryocyte and platelet production through cytokine signaling.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia 1 (autosomal recessive); thrombocythemia 2 (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Primary myelofibrosis; Essential thrombocythemia; Myeloproliferative neoplasm, NOS. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: MPL encodes the thrombopoietin receptor, which regulates hematopoietic stem-cell maintenance and megakaryocyte and platelet production through cytokine signaling.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with congenital amegakaryocytic thrombocytopenia 1 (autosomal recessive); thrombocythemia 2 (autosomal dominant).
